style: Authentic live-action 35mm film still, Kodak Vision3 500T, warm intimate cinematic lighting, late November, realistic skin texture with pores and fine wrinkles, natural expressions, gentle film grain. Adults only.

frames.name: sp_a
frames.prompt: Evening in a warm, lived-in suburban family living room in late November. DAD (Daniel): Black American man, 64, short grey hair, neat full grey beard, kind tired eyes with laugh lines, wire-rim glasses, a brown shawl-collar cardigan over a blue plaid shirt, sits in a worn tan leather armchair, center of the frame, medium-wide shot from standing chest height, everyone visible from the knees up. On the small side table next to his chair: an old chipped cream ceramic coffee mug with steam rising. Standing close around his chair: his DAUGHTER on the left, Black American woman, 34, braids in a low bun, small gold hoops, camel wool coat still on, burgundy scarf; and his SON on the right, Black American man, 30, short fade haircut, trimmed beard, navy puffer jacket unzipped over a grey hoodie. The daughter holds her phone out toward Dad at chest height, playing him a song (screen not visible), smiling with anticipation; the son grins, hands in pockets. Dad looks up at them, puzzled, a half-smile forming. Table lamp glow, bookshelves and framed family photos (no readable faces) blurred behind, a window with dark blue night.

frames.name: sp_b
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, same evening, same armchair: a close-up of Dad's face and shoulders only (same grey beard, glasses, brown cardigan), he laughs with tears welling in his eyes, one hand rising to cover his mouth, overwhelmed and moved, looking up toward his kids off-camera. Shallow depth of field, warm lamp light.

frames.name: sp_c
frames.prompt: Change only: Dad now stands up in front of his armchair holding his old chipped cream coffee mug raised high in a toast, laughing; the daughter and the son raise their own coffee mugs toward his, everyone singing together with open mouths and big smiles. The phone rests on the armchair cushion.

frames.name: sp_d
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, same night, exterior: a modest two-story suburban house with warm glowing windows, a bright yellow porch light on above the front door, bare November trees, frost on the lawn. A dark grey SUV with its headlights on has just pulled into the driveway on the left. Dad (same man, same grey beard, glasses, brown cardigan) stands in the open front doorway under the porch light, one hand raised in a wave. Wide shot from the end of the driveway at standing height, the house and porch fill the middle of the frame, Dad clearly visible. Cool blue night tones with warm amber porch light. Ignore the living room of the reference; only keep Dad's identity.

frames.name: sp_e
frames.prompt: NEW SHOT, same night: just inside the open front door of the house, the porch light and the cold blue night behind. Dad (same grey beard, glasses, brown cardigan) hugs his daughter (same braids in a low bun, camel coat, burgundy scarf) tightly, his chin over her shoulder, mid-sentence, mouth open asking her something, eyes smiling. The son (same navy puffer) stands right behind her on the doorstep holding a duffel bag and a bakery box, grinning. Warm hallway light. Medium shot from inside the hallway, all three faces visible.
